# WildFly MicroProfile GraphQL Feature Pack

> A Galleon feature pack that adds MicroProfile GraphQL support to WildFly. It provides the `microprofile-graphql` Galleon layer, which installs the `microprofile-graphql-smallrye` subsystem backed by SmallRye GraphQL. This enables applications deployed on WildFly to expose GraphQL APIs using the Eclipse MicroProfile GraphQL specification, with support for queries, mutations, GraphQL client (including Vert.x-based), and the GraphiQL developer UI. The feature pack depends on WildFly's core Galleon pack and the WildFly Reactive feature pack.

## Documentation

- [README](./README.md): Project overview, installation instructions using Galleon CLI or WildFly Maven Plugin, and links to quickstarts and specifications
- [Installation Guide (Wiki)](https://github.com/wildfly-extras/wildfly-graphql-feature-pack/wiki/Installation-guide): Detailed installation steps for adding this feature pack to WildFly
- [Supported Versions (Wiki)](https://github.com/wildfly-extras/wildfly-graphql-feature-pack/wiki/Supported-versions-and-future-versions-roadmap): Compatibility matrix showing which feature pack versions work with which WildFly versions
- [Quickstart README](./quickstart/README.md): Step-by-step tutorial demonstrating GraphQL queries, mutations, source fields, and the GraphiQL UI using a Star Wars example application
- [Build Module README](./build/README.md): Explains the build outputs — thin distribution, full distribution, and overlay ZIP

## Feature Pack Definition

- [Galleon Layer Spec](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/layers/standalone/microprofile-graphql/layer-spec.xml): Defines the `microprofile-graphql` layer — depends on `cdi`, `microprofile-config`, and `microprofile-context-propagation` layers; includes the GraphQL subsystem extension and SmallRye GraphQL modules
- [Feature Pack Build Descriptor](./feature-pack/wildfly-feature-pack-build.xml): Galleon build descriptor declaring transitive dependency on `wildfly-ee-galleon-pack` and direct dependencies on `wildfly-galleon-pack` and `wildfly-microprofile-reactive-feature-pack`
- [Feature Group](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/feature_groups/graphql.xml): Galleon feature group definition for the GraphQL subsystem configuration
- [Provisioning Example](./provision.xml): Example Galleon provisioning descriptor showing how to provision a WildFly server with `microprofile-graphql`, `jaxrs-server`, `observability`, and `jmx-remoting` layers

## Subsystem Extension

- [subsystem/](./subsystem/): WildFly subsystem extension implementation for the `microprofile-graphql-smallrye` subsystem
- [MicroProfileGraphQLExtension](./subsystem/src/main/java/org/wildfly/extension/microprofile/graphql/MicroProfileGraphQLExtension.java): Subsystem extension entry point — registers the subsystem parser and model definition
- [MicroProfileGraphQLSubsystemDefinition](./subsystem/src/main/java/org/wildfly/extension/microprofile/graphql/MicroProfileGraphQLSubsystemDefinition.java): Subsystem resource definition with add/remove handlers
- [MicroProfileGraphQLDeploymentProcessor](./subsystem/src/main/java/org/wildfly/extension/microprofile/graphql/deployment/MicroProfileGraphQLDeploymentProcessor.java): Deployment unit processor that integrates SmallRye GraphQL into application deployments
- [GraphiQLUIDeploymentProcessor](./subsystem/src/main/java/org/wildfly/extension/microprofile/graphql/deployment/GraphiQLUIDeploymentProcessor.java): Deployment processor that enables the GraphiQL developer UI endpoint

## JBoss Modules

- [SmallRye GraphQL Module](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/modules/system/layers/base/io/smallrye/graphql/main/module.xml): JBoss Module definition for the SmallRye GraphQL server implementation
- [SmallRye GraphQL API Module](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/modules/system/layers/base/io/smallrye/graphql/api/main/module.xml): JBoss Module for SmallRye GraphQL API
- [SmallRye GraphQL Client API Module](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/modules/system/layers/base/io/smallrye/graphql/client/api/main/module.xml): JBoss Module for the SmallRye GraphQL Client API
- [SmallRye GraphQL Client Vert.x Module](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/modules/system/layers/base/io/smallrye/graphql/client/vertx/main/module.xml): JBoss Module for the Vert.x-based GraphQL Client implementation
- [MicroProfile GraphQL API Module](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/modules/system/layers/base/org/eclipse/microprofile/graphql/api/main/module.xml): JBoss Module for the Eclipse MicroProfile GraphQL specification API
- [Subsystem Extension Module](./feature-pack/src/main/resources/modules/system/layers/base/org/wildfly/extension/microprofile/graphql-smallrye/main/module.xml): JBoss Module for the WildFly subsystem extension

## Quickstart

- [quickstart/](./quickstart/): Example application demonstrating MicroProfile GraphQL with a Star Wars domain model (Film, Hero, LightSaber entities), including GraphQL queries, mutations, source fields, and a typesafe GraphQL client test

## Test Suite

- [testsuite/integration/](./testsuite/integration/): Integration tests covering GraphQL API functionality, GraphiQL UI, security (Elytron), context propagation, batch source queries, async operations, and bean validation
- [testsuite/server-tck/](./testsuite/server-tck/): MicroProfile GraphQL TCK (Technology Compatibility Kit) runner for specification compliance validation
- [testsuite/client-vertx/](./testsuite/client-vertx/): Tests for the Vert.x-based GraphQL client

## Build

- [build/](./build/): Module that provisions a complete WildFly distribution with the GraphQL feature pack installed, producing thin, full, and overlay ZIP artifacts
- [CI Workflow](./.github/workflows/build.yml): GitHub Actions CI configuration
